svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 400GE ZR/ER4/LR4/SR8/FR4/DR4/DR4+/PLR4 and 400G ZR/ZR+ support; 200GE QSFP56 SR4/FR4; 100GE QSFP28 ZR4/ER4/LR4/SR4 (datasheet compatible transceiver list)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 1/10G on the data pair, 10G on the OOB pair (datasheet port list)
svg.data-zr-capacity: up to 8x 400G ZR in ZR-only use, or up to 6 total if any OpenZR+ is mixed in; ZR/OpenZR+ modules must not sit in adjacent ports (HIG port overview)
svg.data-oob: 1x RJ45 100/1000M plus 2x SFP+ 10G, both reaching the x86 (HIG)
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 300 386; EN 55024; EN 55035; BSMI; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A; AS/NZS CISPR 32, Class A; MTCTE

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, SYS row - Off (no power), Solid Green (host CPU/BMC boot complete), Solid Amber (power is up but host CPU/BMC boot failed)
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, FAN row - Off (fans are not initialized), Solid Green (all fans work normal), Blinking Amber (fan fail: one or more fans need service)
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, PSU0 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU0 working normal), Blinking Amber (PSU0 fail, needs service)
g.title: led-psu0

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, PSU1 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU1 working normal), Blinking Amber (PSU1 fail, needs service)
g.title: led-psu1

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, ID row - Off (no power), Blinking Blue (beacon feature is enabled on the switch)
g.title: led-id

g.data-description: HIG Management Port LED table - left lamp Off (no power), Solid Green (1G link-up), Blinking Green (1G TX/RX activity); right lamp Off (no power), Solid Amber (10M/100M link-up), Blinking Amber (10M/100M TX/RX activity). The two lamps do not share a vocabulary, so they are declared per element
g.title: oob

g.data-description: the left stacked SFP+ pair, marked with the network symbol - the second out-of-band path to the x86 (HIG Connecting the OOB Management Cables)
